title: Relative cycles agreeing over generic points are equal

statement_spans.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-uniqueness-extension (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1085-1095

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The forward implication is immediate. Conversely, every point s of the locally Noetherian base is a specialization of a generic point eta of an irreducible component; the cited Properties lemma supplies a morphism from the spectrum of a DVR carrying eta to the generic point and 0 to s; both cycles then have fibres at s mapping to the same element of the closed-fibre cycle group, namely the specialization of the common generic fibre; and the base change map is injective by the relative-fields section, whence the fibres agree everywhere (source lines 1097-1112)

core_obligations: Show the equivalence of alpha = beta and alpha_eta = beta_eta for all generic points eta of irreducible components of S (proof lines 1097-1112). (1) => (2) is immediate (proof line 1098). Assume (2): for every s in S pick a generic point eta as in (2) specializing to s; by properties-lemma-locally-Noetherian-specialization-dvr (tag 054F) find g : S' -> S from the spectrum of a DVR with eta' mapping to eta and 0 mapping to s (proof lines 1099-1104); then alpha_s and beta_s in Z_r(X_s) base change to the same element of Z_r(X_{0'}), namely sp_{X_{S'}/S'}(alpha_{eta'}) with alpha_{eta'} the base change of alpha_eta, since both relative cycles are compatible with specializations and agree over eta (proof lines 1105-1108); since the base change map Z_r(X_s) -> Z_r(X_{0'}) is injective as discussed in section-relative-fields (tag 0H4E), alpha_s = beta_s for all s, whence alpha = beta (proof lines 1109-1111).
proof_roadmap: Forward direction immediate; backward: every point of the locally Noetherian base is a specialization of a generic point (proof lines 1098-1100).
DVR-valued morphism from the Properties lemma connects the generic fibre to the fibre at s (proof lines 1100-1104).
Both cycles specialize to the same closed-fibre cycle and injectivity of the base change map gives equality of fibres (proof lines 1105-1111).
